# Kirchner, Elkamhawy, and Hammer — Entanglement in Few-Nucleon Scattering Events (2024)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Tanja Kirchner, Wael Elkamhawy, and Hans-Werner Hammer, “Entanglement in Few-Nucleon Scattering Events,” *Few-Body Systems* 65 (2024): 29, https://doi.org/10.1007/s00601-024-01897-2.

**Shortened note:** Kirchner, Elkamhawy, and Hammer, “Entanglement.”

**Bibliography:** Kirchner, Tanja, Wael Elkamhawy, and Hans-Werner Hammer. “Entanglement in Few-Nucleon Scattering Events.” *Few-Body Systems* 65 (2024): 29. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00601-024-01897-2.

## Essay use

This article gives a precise pure-two-level-state condition: after normalization and removal of overall phase, the relevant manifold is \(\mathbb{CP}^{1}\), also called the Bloch sphere. It warrants only that local state-space geometry.

**Claim boundary:** it does not identify \(|0\rangle\) and \(|1\rangle\) with QL ground/mark, apply to mixed states or arbitrary multi-qubit systems, or establish a Buddhist, QL, or metaphysical conclusion.

## Passage card — `kirchner-elkamhawy-hammer-2024-entanglement-nucleon-scattering-q001` — pure-state \(\mathbb{CP}^{1}\)
^kirchner-elkamhawy-hammer-2024-entanglement-nucleon-scattering-q001

> “The remaining two real parameters are angles that parameterize the corresponding complex manifold \(\mathbb{CP}^{1}\) of all pure states (projective Hilbert space of complex dimension 1).
